Picking up a <special/>Special ammo brick refills the magazine and grants 100 Reload and <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> increased damage for #e${6+#d} seconds. <heavy/>Heavy ammo bricks grants the buff for #e${9+#d} seconds.

Timer only decreases while the weapon is readied, and remains paused while stowed.
